_comment: 100 project-manager questions over the same MLJ-017 Package 6 General corpus as eval/mlj017-97-variant-batch-input.json. Deliberately SIMPLER than the 97: each question has a short answer -- a file name, a date, a name, an amount, a status, or one short list. No question asks for a multi-part synthesis. Phrasing is the way a GC project manager actually talks ("where is", "do we have", "pull up", "who signed", "what's the status"), so this set exercises file-location and single-fact retrieval rather than long-form reasoning. Ids are pm001-pm100 and are independent of the sqNN ids.
